caption: Resource Details
description: The Resource Details object describes details about resources that were affected by the activity/event.
name: resource_details

created_time.description: The time when the resource was created.

ip.description: The IP address associated with the instance in either IPv4 or IPv6 format.

ip_addresses.description: An array of IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) associated with the device. These may include both public and private IP addresses.

region.description: The cloud region of the resource.

state.description: The state of the resource, normalized to the caption of the state_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source. This carries the source-specific value (e.g. an AWS AMI image state such as available, or an EC2 instance state such as running).

state_id.description: The normalized lifecycle state of the resource, resource-type agnostic. The source-specific value is preserved in the state sibling.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The state is unset or not provided.

1.caption: Pending
1.description: The resource is being created or provisioned and is not yet usable (e.g. AMI pending, EC2 pending).

2.caption: Active
2.description: The resource is created and in service (e.g. AMI available, EC2 running, an enabled resource).

3.caption: Suspended
3.description: The resource is temporarily inactive (e.g. EC2 stopped, a disabled or paused resource).

4.caption: Deprovisioned
4.description: The resource has been removed or retired (e.g. AMI deregistered, EC2 terminated, a deleted resource).

5.caption: Failed
5.description: The resource creation or operation failed, or the resource is in a bad state (e.g. AMI failed, error, or invalid).

6.caption: Transient
6.description: The resource is mid-transition between states (e.g. AMI transient, EC2 stopping or shutting-down).

99.caption: Other
99.description: The state is not mapped. See the state attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

subnet_info.description: Details about the subnet where the resource is located.

uid_alt.description: This is the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

vpc_uid.description: The VPC ID where the resource is located (e.g. vpc-12345678900).
